metadata.title: The properties of hypervelocity stars and S-stars originating from an eccentric disc around a supermassive black hole

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies simulated populations of HVSs and S-stars rather than individual Galactic-unbound candidates with stellar identifiers (T:p3-b9, T:p6-b6); its HVS comparison sample is collective (T:p4-b1). The only individually named star, S0-102, is cited merely as an observed, tightly bound S-star used for a semi-major-axis comparison (T:p7-b3), not as a Galactic-unbound candidate.
